description: The bar chart illustrates the token count distribution across five categories (labeled 0 through 4 on the horizontal axis) for two components: “Reasoning” (represented by orange bars) and “Demonstration” (represented by blue bars stacked on top of the orange bars), as part of a graph-based analysis of reasoning in LLMs. The vertical axis, labeled “Token Count,” ranges from 0 to 7000 in increments of 1000. The first bar (category 0) is entirely orange and reaches 6393 tokens, with no blue “Demonstration” component. For categories 1 through 4, the orange “Reasoning” portion is topped by a blue “Demonstration” segment, and red downward-pointing arrows with negative values (–1952, –1613, –1040, –1379) indicate reductions from a reference line near 6000 tokens, suggesting a comparison or baseline. The total token count for each category decreases from 6393 (category 0) to approximately 5000–5300 for categories 1–4, with the “Demonstration” portion contributing a smaller, variable share. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of “Reasoning” tokens and the relative consistency of “Demonstration” additions across categories 1–4.
